render.prompt: Static camera, no push, no zoom, no pan, one single unbroken six-second take from this one camera only. Start exactly from the first frame and end exactly on the given final frame, one continuous take without any cut; the camera never changes position, height or angle. The closed leather book, the Portfolio Handbook with its gold title, brass corners, red ribbon marker and the leather strap buckled across it, lies centred on the flat magenta plate exactly as in the first frame. The buckle unfastens, the strap slides off the cover and drops away off the bottom of the frame and is gone. The front cover lifts from its right edge and swings open on its spine toward the left, the book turning to lie flat and face-on to the camera as it opens, the pages fanning once and settling, until it lies fully open as a two-page spread of blank hand-torn parchment with the stitched spine down the middle, exactly as in the final frame, and rests there for the last second. Nothing else moves; the magenta stays flat with no shadow anywhere. Layered paper cut-out craft with real material texture: worn leather, embossed gold lettering, brass corner plates and buckle, hand-torn parchment pages, soft studio light from the upper left, the book centred on a flat, pure, even magenta background that never changes and carries no shadow. Physics: the book stays centred, the strap comes free before the cover lifts, the cover swings on its spine like a real hinge, the pages stay bound at the spine and fan then settle, nothing appears from nowhere and nothing but the strap leaves, the magenta stays flat with no shadow anywhere, and the last frame equals the given final frame exactly. No text on the pages, no new logos.
